svg.desc: OS: Full-stack Developer; Host: Somewhere with good coffee; Uptime: 7 years, 8 months; Shell: zsh; Web: TypeScript · React · Svelte; Backend: Python · Go · PostgreSQL; Ops: Linux · Docker · GitHub Actions; Now: building readmefetch; Contact: dev@example.com.
